seo.title: GIF Merger — Combine GIFs Online
seo.description: Combine GIFs in order into one animation. Arrange files, preview the result, and download it from your browser.

strings.Put GIFs in order and download one anima: Put GIFs in order and download one animation.
strings.Your browser processes the files on your: Your browser processes the files on your device. Nothing is uploaded for conversion.
strings.Enable JavaScript to merge GIFs in your: Enable JavaScript to merge GIFs in your browser.
strings.Join the animations in sequence. Arrange: Join the animations in sequence. Arrange the files before creating the result.
strings.Select between 2 and 10 GIF files from y: Select between 2 and 10 GIF files from your device. The total input size can be up to 30 MiB.
strings.Move files up or down, or remove one. Th: Move files up or down, or remove one. The GIFs will play one after another in the order shown.
strings.Create the animation, review the result: Create the animation, review the result and download the GIF. Processing happens in your browser.
strings.What to expect from the result: What to expect from the result
strings.The output canvas uses the largest width: The output canvas uses the largest width and height among the inputs. Frames stay at their original size, centered, with transparent space around smaller images.
strings.Each frame retains its recorded delay. T: Each frame retains its recorded delay. The combined animation loops indefinitely; original per-file loop counts are not retained.
strings.Frames are re-encoded and colors may cha: Frames are re-encoded and colors may change during palette reduction. GIF transparency is either fully transparent or opaque.
strings.No. Your chosen GIFs and the merged resu: No. Your chosen GIFs and the merged result are processed on your device. Loading the website and its analytics still involves network requests; see the {link0}.
strings.Choose 2–10 GIFs with a combined size of: Choose 2–10 GIFs with a combined size of at most 30 MiB and no more than 400 frames. The output canvas can be at most 4,096 pixels on either side and 4 million pixels per frame; the complete output may contain at most 20 million canvas pixels. Device memory can impose a lower practical limit.
strings.Can I put GIFs side by side?: Can I put GIFs side by side?
strings.This tool joins GIFs sequentially, so on: This tool joins GIFs sequentially, so one animation plays after the other. It does not combine them side by side.
strings.Can I split the merged GIF into images?: Can I split the merged GIF into images?
strings.Yes. Open the result in the {link0} to p: Yes. Open the result in the {link0} to preview its frames and download PNG images, subject to the splitter’s limits.

seo.title: GIF to JPG Converter — Save GIF Frames as JPEG
seo.description: Convert a GIF to JPG images in your browser. Choose a background, save one frame, or download selected frames as a ZIP.

strings.Free online GIF to JPG converter: Free online GIF to JPG converter
strings.Save a single frame or a set of JPEG ima: Save a single frame or a set of JPEG images. Choose a background for transparent areas.
strings.Your GIF is processed in your browser. T: Your GIF is processed in your browser. The conversion does not upload your file.
strings.Enable JavaScript to convert GIF frames: Enable JavaScript to convert GIF frames in your browser.
strings.How to convert a GIF to JPG: How to convert a GIF to JPG
strings.Choose the image or frames you need and: Choose the image or frames you need and save them without uploading your GIF for conversion.
strings.Select one GIF from your device. The bro: Select one GIF from your device. The browser reconstructs its complete frames, including updates stored as partial images.
strings.Find a frame in the preview. Check indiv: Find a frame in the preview. Check individual frames if you want a selection; you can also save the whole sequence.
strings.Set the output quality and background co: Set the output quality and background color, then download one image or a numbered ZIP of selected or all frames.
strings.What to expect from JPG output: What to expect from JPG output
strings.JPEG does not support transparency. Tran: JPEG does not support transparency. Transparent parts of each frame are placed over the background color you choose; the default is white.
Choose an output quality before saving. JPEG is lossy, so compression can change fine details and colors; it cannot restore detail absent from the original GIF.
strings.Each JPG uses the GIF's canvas dimension: Each JPG uses the GIF's canvas dimensions. The downloaded images are still pictures and do not include animation timing.
About frames, output and file handling.
strings.Can I convert an animated GIF to one JPG: Can I convert an animated GIF to one JPG?
strings.Yes. Preview the frame you want and down: Yes. Preview the frame you want and download it as a single JPEG. The JPG is a still image and will not play the source animation.
strings.JPEG cannot store transparency. Choose a: JPEG cannot store transparency. Choose a background color, then save the frame; transparent areas are rendered over that color.
strings.Can I save every frame as JPG?: Can I save every frame as JPG?
strings.Yes. Download all frames as a ZIP of num: Yes. Download all frames as a ZIP of numbered JPG images, or select only the frames you need. The ZIP does not preserve animation timing.
strings.Use the {link0} to export PNG frames, or: Use the {link0} to export PNG frames, or try {link1} in a browser that supports WebP encoding.
strings.No. Your chosen GIF and converted images: No. Your chosen GIF and converted images are processed on your device. Loading the website and its analytics still involves network requests; see the {link0}.
strings.One GIF can be up to 30 MiB and 1,000 fr: One GIF can be up to 30 MiB and 1,000 frames. Dimension, pixel and memory safeguards can reject a smaller file, and each ZIP is limited to 128 MiB of image data. See the {link0}.
Preview and save frames as PNG images.
Save static frames in WebP format.
